Daten ändern sich: Ein Tier wird älter,: Data changes: an animal gets older, an owner moves, an animal has found its partner and leaves the site. With UPDATE you change, with DELETE you delete. Both need a WHERE – otherwise it hits all rows. That has already happened in real companies.

Sagt, welche Spalte welchen neuen Wert b: Says which column gets which new value.
Eine Änderung zurücknehmen. Bei DELETE g: To take back a change. With DELETE that is not possible!
Eine Kopie der Daten, falls etwas schief: A copy of the data in case something goes wrong – e.g. your .db file.
Bei Pfotenglück ist Betrieb: Steckbriefe: It is busy at Pfotenglück: profiles change, animals find partners. You practise on a copy of the sample site – every run starts again with the original. Then you look after and test your own site.

Eine Bedingung, die genau eine Zeile tri: A condition that hits exactly one row
WHERE wählt nur aus – was passiert, sagt: WHERE only selects – what happens is said by the command before it.
Die id ist eindeutig – also genau eine Z: The id is unique – so exactly one row.
Woher soll SQL wissen, dass Bello gemein: How should SQL know that Bello is meant? The name is nowhere in the command.
Leider nicht. WHERE ist freiwillig – ohn: Unfortunately not. WHERE is optional – without it, it simply hits all rows.
Ohne WHERE gilt SET für jede Zeile. Prob: Without WHERE, SET applies to every row. Try it:
Das Alter ist eine Zahl – ohne Anführung: The age is a number – without quotation marks.
✔ Richtig – genau 1 Zeile geändert. Bell: ✔ Correct – exactly 1 row changed. Bello is 6.
Mehrere Spalten nach SET werden mit Komm: Several columns after SET are separated with a comma, not with AND.
✔ Richtig – beide Spalten in einem Befeh: ✔ Correct – both columns in one command, exactly one row.
Lösung: UPDATE tiere SET sucht = 'Freund: Solution: UPDATE tiere SET sucht = 'Freundschaft', hobby = 'Kartons' WHERE id = 2
Bei DELETE gibt es kein * – es wird imme: With DELETE there is no * – the whole row is always deleted: DELETE FROM tiere WHERE ….
✔ Goldi is out – 23 animals are left.
✔ Fall gelöst! Mit WHERE ist nur Blub we: ✔ Case solved! With WHERE only Blub is gone. In a real database, without a backup, all animals would have been lost.
